maddeler.e:
يحقا (form I)
# يَحِقَّا (yaḥiqqā) /ja.ħiq.qaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يَحُقَّا (yaḥuqqā) /ja.ħuq.qaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يُحَقَّا (yuḥaqqā) /ju.ħaq.qaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
